slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: How many trained pilots does one training jet produce per year, and is this rate constant across both years?
slot_scores.rationale: Directly asks for the per-jet annual training capacity, fully covering the hidden slot.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: No question asks how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarifies the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Do the training jets allocated in year 1 remain available for training in year 2, or are they consumed or retired after year 1 so that only the jets allocated in year 2 contribute to year 2 pilot production?
slot_scores.rationale: Touches the training timeline and carryover into year 2, but does not explicitly ask when training starts or how long the training program lasts.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Training starts in year 1 and lasts through year 2, with only year 1 and year 2 training contributions counted.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent confirmed training-jet carryover, but never explicitly asked or confirmed the program's start year or duration; the final model assumes the two-year timeline.

stopping_behavior.rationale: H1 was resolved, but H3 was only partially clarified before READY_TO_MODEL; the exact start/duration of training remained unconfirmed.

summary: The agent recovered the key training capacity and many operational constraints, but missed the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping and only partially clarified the training timeline before modeling.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
